C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES.Summary: Three export-adjacent paths carry document data past its boundary silently: the styled HTML and Word export embed pass base64-embeds any locally readable image — including files outside the exporting document's directory — into the exported artifact without asking; HTML export renders PlantUML diagrams as remote img references to https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml whose URLs carry the deflate-encoded diagram source, so the exported file sends diagram text to a third-party server on every view with no disclosure at export time; and the diff baseline command reads the {path}.before sidecar with raw std::fs::read_to_string, bypassing the M-010/M-013-B validation funnel every other filesystem command rides. This change makes each path either local-only in effect or explicitly consented with the exact file list or remote destination named, and routes the diff sidecar read through the existing funnel unchanged.
C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES.Problem: Findings from the 2026-11-21 security re-audit (commit 229b3a69; brief ids F-005/F-008 image embed, F-006 PlantUML remote render, plus the unfenced diff sidecar read). All three confirmed in current code. (1) Image embed without scope check: src/renderer/src/util/exportImages.js resolveImageSrc (lines 81-119) resolves document-relative, POSIX-absolute, Windows drive-letter and extended-prefix paths anywhere on disk, and embedLocalImages (lines 135-193) stats and reads each resolved path and rewrites its img src to a data: URL with no comparison against the document directory it was given — the baseDir parameter only anchors relative references. The current unit matrix even cements the behavior: tests/renderer/util/exportImages.test.js corner C-2 embeds an absolute path against '/irrelevant/base'. Both export branches run the pass — editor.vue handleExport styledHtml (line 2286) and docx (line 2322) — so the exported .html/.docx silently carries the bytes of files from outside the document's folder (browser history dirs, other projects, anything the markdown once referenced). (2) Remote PlantUML render: src/muya/lib/parser/render/plantuml.js defines PLANTUML_URL = 'https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml' (line 4) and insertImgElement (lines 47-57) emits an img whose src embeds the deflate+base64url-encoded diagram source per the PlantUML text-encoding scheme (encode, lines 35-45); muya/lib/utils/exportHtml.js renderDiagram (lines 186-190) inserts exactly that img into the styled HTML export. There is no local render path anywhere: no plantuml reference exists in src-tauri, and the C-56 figure-raster surface (muya/lib/utils/diagramExport.js EXPORTABLE_FIGURE_SELECTOR) deliberately covers MERMAID and VEGA-LITE only, naming flowchart/sequence/plantuml a follow-up non-goal. The live preview rides the same remote URL (muya/lib/parser/render/index.js line 396), so the transport is already remote — but the export boundary is silent: the exported file ships a URL that hands the diagram source to plantuml.com every time a recipient opens it, and nothing at export time tells the user. (3) Unfenced diff sidecar read: src-tauri/src/m031_diff.rs mt_diff_baseline (lines 3-28) builds '{path}.before' and reads it with std::fs::read_to_string — no SecurityCtx, no m010_security::check_path, no regular-file gate, no MAX_READ_BYTES cap — making it the only filesystem-reading command outside the m013b funnel that C-SEC-SAVE-HANDLE hardened (check_path, re-fence, deny-on-change in src-tauri/src/m013b/fs.rs write_validated_bytes, lines 171-210). The command's own verification plan already demands the fence: V-M-031 negative assertion NA3 ('.before path MUST NOT bypass SecurityCtx — every mt_diff_baseline call validates resolved path through same sandbox check as mt_read_file'), failure scenario F2 (outside-sandbox sidecar → BLOCK_BASELINE_FAILED reason=sandbox_violation), edge case E6 (symlinked sidecar resolved-target check) and the stated prerequisite 'V-M-010 (SecurityCtx sandbox for .before path resolution)' — none of which the shipped code implements. A symlinked or redirected sidecar therefore reads arbitrary files outside the workspace into the diff view. Severity: medium across the three — document data (image bytes, diagram sources, sidecar file contents) leaves its boundary without consent or lands in the renderer unfenced; no privilege escalation beyond the running app is claimed as fixed.
C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES.Relationship: Same security re-audit family as C-SEC-SAVE-HANDLE (run be2f52f880bc), whose NonGoals explicitly deferred 'F-003 (HTML export read scope)' and 'F-005 (diff .before sidecar bypass)' as separate changes — this spec is where those deferred items land, under the 2026-11-21 run's ids. Finding-id discrepancy, flagged for the orchestrator: in the prior run F-005 named the diff sidecar bypass, while the current brief's F-005/F-008 name the image embed and F-006 the PlantUML render; the diff sidecar read carries no explicit id in the current brief. This spec is drafted from the brief's inline descriptions, which the code walk independently confirms at the cited lines; re-verify the intended finding ids before approval. Consent-dialog precedents reused: C-SEC-STREAM-SCOPE ('make the pairing dialog state exactly what the user is approving'), the C-UPDATER-ROLLBACK notification-stack confirm card (src/renderer/src/components/rollbackConfirm/index.vue — sticky singleton entry via dedupKey, Confirm/Cancel dispatching to store actions). PlantUML decision recorded in Goals and Assumptions: explicit-address consent dialog, not local render — the codebase has no local PlantUML engine (no plantuml in src-tauri, no bundled JS renderer; muya's plantuml.js is only a URL builder), so a local renderer would be a net-new engine bundle outside a boundary-hardening change, while remote render is already the app's established transport.

Goals.Goal: Embed scope with consent: the M-065 pass classifies each resolved image path as in-scope (inside the exporting document's directory subtree) or out-of-scope; out-of-scope files are embedded only after an explicit consent that lists them — resolved path and count — before any read; declining keeps those img references untouched and counts them as skipped, so the existing embedded/total notice stays honest; in-scope embedding is unchanged.

PlantUML export consent: the styledHtml and docx export flows embed a plantuml.com reference in the exported artifact only after an explicit consent that names https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml as the remote destination and states what leaves (the PlantUML diagram source text, per-diagram count); declining produces an export containing no plantuml.com URL — diagrams export as their literal fenced source or an equally honest non-remote placeholder (the plan pins one).

Funneled diff read: mt_diff_baseline takes the SecurityCtx and reads the .before sidecar through the same M-010 fence as the funnel commands (check_path with the existing denial codes, regular-file gate, MAX_READ_BYTES cap), with denials surfacing through the existing baseline-failure path (BLOCK_BASELINE_FAILED, the diff view's exit-with-notice behavior); a valid in-sandbox sidecar reads exactly as before, and the git-show fallback is untouched.

Honest surfaces: the M-065/M-066/M-031/M-012 module contracts, graph summaries and verification scenarios state the consent gates and the funnelled sidecar read; the new unit pins fail on pre-fix code and pass post-fix; no documented behavior changes beyond the ones this spec lists explicitly.

Constraints.Constraint: Funnel-reuse semantics disclosed up front: riding fs_read_inner as-is would replace the sidecar read's strict UTF-8 failure (V-M-031 F7: invalid UTF-8 → error → git fallback) with M-014 decode-and-replace, and would apply the 10 MiB MAX_READ_BYTES cap to sidecars. The plan either accepts those deltas and updates the F7 pin honestly, or fences at the m031 boundary with m010_security::check_path plus read_to_string, preserving F7 — exactly one is chosen and justified; in both cases check_path is reused unchanged and denial codes come from the existing MT_FS_PATH_DENIED family.

Consent UI reuses the existing patterns, no new dialog framework: the notification-stack confirm card (components/rollbackConfirm/index.vue pattern — sticky entry, dedupKey singleton, Confirm/Cancel into store actions) with C-SEC-STREAM-SCOPE disclosure style (state exactly what the user approves); i18n keys land in all ten locale files in the same change. Console output keeps the V-M-065 privacy convention — counts only; full resolved paths appear solely inside the consent dialog the user is asked to approve.

Export behavior otherwise preserved: pdf/print branches never run the embed pass (corner C-12 unchanged); remote http(s) and data: image sources stay untouched by the embed pass; the docx converter (M-066) consumes the same post-consent HTML without its own gate; no new IPC commands; the mt_diff_baseline renderer invocation shape is unchanged (State injected by Tauri) so diffView.vue and the diff stores need no renderer change — denials surface as the existing baseline-failure notice.

Repository artifacts stay English; module contracts, module maps and CHANGE_SUMMARY blocks in touched files are synchronized; graph and verification references are updated with the change; no release actions.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Export format changes: no new formats, no redesign of the styled-HTML structure beyond the consent-gated img handling, no change to what the pdf/print branches do.
Image optimization: no resizing, recompression, format conversion or cap changes — the 8 MiB EMBED_CAP_BYTES and the MIME table stay as pinned.
New export options UI beyond the two consent dialogs: no settings-page entries, no remembered-consent preference — consent is requested per export, and declining is never persisted.

PlantUML local rendering: no bundled PlantUML engine, no wasm/JS renderer promotion, no PlantUML server self-hosting or configurable server URL; the remote transport itself is unchanged, only its disclosure at export time.

The live preview's remote PlantUML fetch (muya/lib/parser/render/index.js line 396) — same transport, but editor-preview behavior, not the export boundary; named as the follow-up direction with its own approval.
M-010 fence semantics, the m013b funnel's validation logic, the m047 bookmark layer, and the C-56 figure-raster surface (MERMAID/VEGA-LITE) — all untouched.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Out-of-scope embed refusal, fails before the fix and passes after: with consent absent, an img whose resolved path lies outside the exporting document's directory subtree is not embedded — its src survives and it is counted as skipped — while an in-scope sibling image still embeds exactly as corner C-1 pins today; with consent granted for an explicit list, the pass embeds exactly the listed files and nothing else — an additional out-of-scope img injected beyond the granted list stays unembedded and skipped (finding checklist: out-of-scope embed refused without consent; consent grants exactly the listed files).

Consent-list integrity: the out-of-scope candidate list shown for approval is deduplicated by resolved path, matches the accounting the pass reports, and carries the resolved paths; declining flips no in-scope behavior and the embedded/total notice reports the declined references as skipped, never as embedded.

PlantUML consent, per the recorded dialog decision: without consent the exported styled HTML contains no plantuml.com URL (literal fenced source or the plan's pinned honest placeholder) in both the styledHtml and docx branches; with consent the only remote diagram reference emitted names exactly https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml; both branches pinned at unit level in the new gate tests and the editor wiring tests (finding checklist: explicit-address dialog before export).

Diff read through the funnel, source-shape pin plus behavior test: mt_diff_baseline's sidecar read performs m010_security::check_path under the command's SecurityCtx — no raw std::fs::read_to_string on an unfenced path remains in m031_diff.rs — and a malicious-path fixture (a {path}.before symlink resolving outside the sandbox) is denied with the MT_FS_PATH_DENIED family and surfaces as BLOCK_BASELINE_FAILED reason=sandbox_violation with no bytes returned, closing V-M-031 NA3/F2/E6 (finding checklist: diff reads ride the fs funnel).

Existing behavior stays green with only the explicitly listed pin updates: the M-065 unit matrix passes except corner C-2, which is re-pinned to the consent semantics; the m031 suites pass with their fixtures moved inside a sandbox root; the m013b::fs and m010_security funnel suites pass unchanged, proving no funnel modification.

The touched module contracts, the M-065/M-066/M-031/M-012 graph summaries and the V-M-065/V-M-031/V-M-012 verification surfaces state the consent gates, the funnelled sidecar read and the per-export (non-persisted) consent semantics honestly, and grace lint with --change C-EXPORT-BOUNDARIES passes target and final assertions.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The out-of-scope-refusal and PlantUML-consent unit pins fail on pre-fix code and pass post-fix; the sandbox-violation diff fixture fails pre-fix (bytes returned) and passes post-fix (denied, no bytes); the M-065 matrix stays green except the re-pinned C-2 corner; the diff renderer suites stay green with no renderer change; the funnel suites (m013b::fs, m010_security) stay green unchanged; the ten-locale key completeness rides the existing editor-export wiring test convention; final GRACE assertions and current-state integrity pass.

Assumptions.Assumption: The brief's finding ids are authoritative for this change (F-005/F-008 image embed, F-006 PlantUML; the diff sidecar read is the brief's third item); the prior-run F-005 id collision is flagged in Relationship and re-verified by the orchestrator before approval.

Scope definition: the document's directory scope means the subtree under the exporting document's own directory (platform-normalized prefix comparison); an open workspace does not widen the embed scope in this change — if the plan proves workspace-resident assets are a common in-scope case, widening is justified there and re-approved, not assumed.

The PlantUML fix is the explicit-address consent dialog, decided from code evidence: no local PlantUML engine exists in the repository (no plantuml in src-tauri; muya's renderer only builds the remote URL; the C-56 raster surface names plantuml a non-goal), while remote render is already the app's live-preview transport — a local renderer is a net-new engine bundle outside this boundary-hardening change.
Consent is requested per export and never persisted; a future remembered-consent preference is new options UI and out of scope per this spec's NonGoals.
